movelist.name: Growl
movelist.effect: Growl lowers all Legal Targets Attack 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Take Down
movelist.effect: You may perform a Trip Maneuver against the target as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Sand Attack
movelist.effect: The target is Blinded until the end of their next turn.

movelist.name: Leech Seed
movelist.effect: At the beginning of each of the target’s turns, Leech Seed’s target loses a Tick of Hit Points. Leech Seed’s user then gains Hit Points equal to the amount the target lost. Leech Seed lasts until the target faints or is returned to a Poké Ball. Grass Types and targets immune to Grass Attacks are immune to Leech Seed.

abilities.name: Seasonal
abilities.effect: The user gains an Ability based on the season. - Spring: Run Away - Summer: Grass Pelt - Autumn: Rivalry - Winter: Thick Fat

abilities.name: Sap Sipper
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the damage and effects of Grass-Type attacks. If the user is hit by a Grass-Type attack, they gain +1 CS in their choice of Attack or Special Attack. Defensive.
